# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome young lady with long, bright golden hair and large, bright-blue eyes. She has a brilliant complexion and a plump, showy figure.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoys the pleasant things of life. She is easily frightened, prone to nervousness, and frequently preoccupied with young men, compliments, and romance rather than academic pursuits.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Traits

- Handsome  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- Cheerful and good-tempered  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- Nervous and easily frightened  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)</sub>
- Preoccupied with boys and romance  <sub>[v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058)</sub>

## Goals

- To have dozens of suitors and enjoy a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and childhood companion of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews. She attended Avonlea school and Sunday school, participating in group games, play-acting, and local events. She later attended Queen's Academy alongside her classmates and was recognized as the handsomest girl of her year. After completing her studies, she took a teaching position in Carmody. During this period, she received a marriage proposal from Nelson Atkins, which she rejected after discovering he had copied his words directly from an etiquette book.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058)_
